title: BRUNO PRESEZZI
subtitle: Presobene Gin
description:
Building a distinctive brand identity for a new gin label.
A branding and positioning project developed for Presobene to support the launch of a new gin brand, including tone of voice, visual identity, color palette, typography, and brand positioning.
The initiative was supported by a strategic marketing campaign and the creation of social and media assets to strengthen the brand’s presence in the premium spirits market.
